newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: QNI says intends to pay final dividend.
newsitem.headline: QNI says intends to pay final dividend.

text.p: Nickel producer QNI Ltd, which earlier announced it is to merge its nickel operations with those of South Africa's Gencor Ltd, said on Wednesday it intended to pay a final dividend for the year to June 30, 1997.
"QNI intends, in the absence of unforeseen circumstances, to declare a final unfranked dividend in respect of the year ending June 30, 1997," the company said in a statement.
QNI said shareholders, excluding Gencor, would receive the dividend irrespective of whether a planned A$260 million capital return had been completed before or after the payment date.
"Gencor and the directors of QNI expect that QNI's current dividend policy will remain unchanged," the company said.
QNI paid a A$0.02 per share dividend in the six months to December 31, 1996.
